shared_executable_evidence: The two 373760-byte executables differ in 62 bytes across DOS-stub/tail padding, at 0x4a..0x69 and 0x5b3d6..0x5b3f5. Their executable sections and all four embedded PE images are identical.

Outer VA 0x00401c30 is the installation workflow. It checks virtual-machine process/path artifacts and exits through a reporting branch when found. VA 0x00401450 writes the embedded kernel driver; VA 0x00401770 creates/starts its kernel-driver service. Other branches enable SeLoadDriverPrivilege and call resolved ZwLoadDriver. It eventually invokes rundll32.exe safemon.dll hook2.

Carved driver at file offset 0xba50: entry VA 0x000a803e jumps to 0x0001586c, which initializes the device and calls 0x00015262. Initialization drops beep.sys, NtHook.sys and safemon.dll, configures their services and initializes concealment and injection paths.

Driver VA 0x000114f6 resolves NtQueryDirectoryFile and other native syscall indexes from ntdll. VA 0x0001334a calls the original directory query then removes matching records by adjusting links or compacting the caller buffer. VA 0x00014234 installs the syscall interception; VA 0x00012bda unregisters process callbacks after matching security-driver names.

Driver VA 0x00012f00 reads the disk and writes boot/payload sectors through the IRP wrapper 0x00012dd2, including an offset-zero MBR write. Embedded real-mode code at driver offset 0x6c0c saves/replaces INT 13h; 0x6cfe writes a relocated CALL FAR into loaded boot code. The hook chains the original disk-read handler and searches the read buffer before patching it.

Driver image-load callback VA 0x00014ad8 targets services and browser/explorer processes, allocates remote memory, builds an import descriptor for safemon.dll and rewrites the loaded image import-directory fields. This is a concrete payload-loading path, not just API text.

Carved safemon.dll at outer offset 0x147d8 exports hook2 (VA 0x1000ab70), which enables debug privilege and reaches VA 0x10005eb0: locate explorer.exe, allocate remote memory, write the DLL path, resolve LoadLibraryA and CreateRemoteThread with that path.

RAT VA 0x1000e290 loops over key states with GetAsyncKeyState, handles shift/caps/backspace/Enter and hands text to 0x1000e050. Foreground-window context comes from 0x1000e180. At 0x1000e050 the text is XOR-copied with key 0x62 into a new buffer which is passed to the write API. This encoding conceals log contents; it is not ransomware file encryption.

RAT VA 0x10010a30 dynamically resolves GetClipboardData(CF_TEXT), GlobalLock and related APIs, copies text into a record beginning with tag 0x77 and passes the record to manager transmission function 0x1000e840. The command dispatcher calls this clipboard routine in its 0x18 command case. Gh0st-style manager RTTI corroborates family identity.

The collector filename lists multiple unrelated families, but the bytes establish NtHook/Gh0st-derived behavior. No Amadey, DarkGate, Rhadamanthys, SmokeLoader or ransomware identity was inferred from that name.
